tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search the How It Spread library of viral cases (films, products, memes, campaigns) by text, kind, mechanic or platform. Returns each case's Spread Score, dates, platforms, mechanics, an image URL and the case URL to cite.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: One case: its dated spread timeline (seed, first amplifier, platform jumps, press, peak), Spread Score and citation. Fields that need sign-in come back locked, with the case URL where the full record is.

tools.name: list_mechanics
tools.description: The closed vocabulary of spread mechanics, each defined, with how many cases use it.
